recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants all concrete canonical resources to replace local business-version wording with canonical-version wording, handle that as a separate explicit consistency tracker rather than expanding FHIR-47363 after application.
issue_request: FHIR-47363 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 change request asking whether CanonicalResource-style version values, raised from SubscriptionTopic.version wording, are tied to canonical URLs, identifiers, or both. The final resolution was to update CanonicalResource text to indicate that this element represents the canonical version for consistency.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by commit a0e14c3b8eec39d4c876488bf58b842423be1b0b in HL7/fhir pull request #3967. That commit changed CanonicalResource.version from business-version wording to canonical-version wording and updated the CanonicalResource.versionAlgorithm explanation.
additional_context: CanonicalResource is active in fhir.ini as an interface, and SubscriptionTopic is an active resource that implements it. Concrete canonical resources, including SubscriptionTopic.version, still contain some local business-version short text, but the approved Jira resolution and PR implementation targeted the CanonicalResource definition rather than a global rewrite across all implementers. Confluence minutes confirm the 2025-03-31 FHIR-I block vote approval; Zulip searches found no substantive conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source/canonicalresource/structuredefinition-CanonicalResource.xml already defines CanonicalResource.version as the canonical version and explains canonical [url]|[version] references, satisfying the approved issue scope.
